# NerdWallet

> > NerdWallet is a personal finance platform providing expert comparisons, reviews, and recommendations for credit cards, banking, loans, insurance, and investment products.

NerdWallet helps consumers make smarter financial decisions through data-driven product comparisons, calculators, and educational content. The platform features award-winning credit cards from major issuers including Wells Fargo, Capital One, Chase, and American Express, along with comprehensive guides across banking, investing, mortgages, and insurance.

## Key Topics

- Credit Cards
- Cash Back Rewards
- Travel Rewards
- Wells Fargo Active Cash Card
- Capital One Savor Cash Rewards Credit Card
- Chase Sapphire Preferred Card
- American Express
- Personal Finance

- Banking

- Investment Products
- Best Credit Cards 2026
- Dining Rewards
